about: Every generated-artifact channel committed in this repository. Read by affected-channels.mjs; --verify-table fails when the tree has a generator, ledger or generated file that no channel claims. Commands run from the repository root.

channels.summary: The stopping step of every emission-order row's trace (cases b, c, d, a, then e), written by its vitest producer as a whole generated Aiken module that checks each step through the one-step dispatcher. The on-chain half runs the module's focused aiken check: about 3.9 GB peak with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1, more at default threads, and about 4.5 GB for each failing row.

sync.run: MIDGARD_WRITE_EMISSION_ORDER_ROWS=1 pnpm --dir demo/midgard-validation exec vitest run tests/emission-order.aiken-rows.test.ts

check.run: pnpm --dir demo/midgard-validation exec vitest run tests/emission-order.aiken-rows.test.ts && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 ./scripts/aiken check onchain/aiken -m midgard/validation_machine_tests/emission_order_rows

ci.step: Build, typecheck, and test Midgard validation

Writes secrets/acceptance.env under the devnet run directory (MIDGARD_PHASE4_RUN_DIR); nothing it writes is committed.
Copies the untracked onchain/aiken/plutus.json and its gitignored build record from another checkout; nothing it writes is committed.
Writes a stress corpus to a caller-chosen path at run time; nothing is committed.
Writes independent compiler receipts, private source archives and untracked blueprints only to a caller-chosen new release-evidence directory; nothing it writes is committed.
Writes the verified public image build-input identity inside the isolated image build; nothing it writes is committed.

Declared F04 runtime producer writes genuine signed workflow transaction measurements to a caller-chosen new private evidence file; no tracked output or automatic complete-release profile is produced.
